title: JA Diner Joomla uses the gated step chain and unsupported variants cannot provision
steps: Run the step-chain switch and database-backed site creation tests with TEST_DATABASE_URL pointing to an isolated test database.
expect: JA Boxing J6 and JA Diner J6 start the step-chain frame with the owned research revision and preserve the selected quickstart in the host provision request.
The environment master switch blocks both candidates before any site, host job or brief run is created.
Published JA Kinetic J6 remains refused with STEP_CHAIN_OFF; JA Diner WordPress remains off.
fence: Existing allow-list plus the existing STEP_CHAIN_ENABLED master switch

tests: the contract names the chain workflow and the candidate templates
a listed template runs the chain only while the master switch is on
a version or release prefix on the quickstart does not change the template
a template that is not listed, or no quickstart, never runs the chain
the enabled ja-boxing template starts the frame with the research revision as its brief
the enabled ja-diner template starts the frame with the research revision as its brief
the step chain is refused, with nothing claimed, for another account’s revision, a template not enabled or the switch off
